description:
VPN, proxy and bot protection for Minecraft Bedrock & Java servers and proxies.
Website · Get started for free · News

--- **Kordon** keeps VPNs, proxies, bots and suspicious clients off your Minecraft server, while real players join without delay. This repository contains the source code of the Kordon plugin for **Lumi / Nukkit** (Bedrock), **BungeeCord** and **Velocity** (Java). The plugin connects your server or proxy to the [Kordon](https://kordonlabs.com) service, where you manage everything from the web panel. No config files. > **Kordon has a free plan with no time limit:** 1,000 checks a day, enough for a small server. > Paid plans add higher limits, more servers, a team, and advanced filters. > See [pricing](https://kordonlabs.com/#pricing) or [create an account](https://panel.kordonlabs.com/register). ## Features - **Checks every login** before the player reaches your server: VPNs, proxies, Tor, hosting and residential proxies. - **Kordon's shared database:** an address caught on any server protected by Kordon is blocked on yours too. - **Bot attack protection:** detects bursts of bot connections. - **Country and nickname filters**, mobile carrier and network (AS) rules, and maintenance mode. - **Whitelist and blacklist** of nicknames, IPs and IP ranges, managed in the panel or in-game. - **Live view of your server:** who is online, where they connect from, their client and version, and one-click kicks from the panel. - **Login log and statistics:** block reasons, attacks, new players, clients and join domains. - **Observe mode:** see who would be blocked without blocking anyone. - **Custom messages** for blocked players and staff notifications in chat. - **Fail-safe:** if Kordon cannot be reached, the plugin follows your setting and either lets everyone in or nobody. Availability of some features depends on your plan. ## Compatibility | Platform | Versions | |---|---| | **Lumi / Nukkit** (Bedrock) | Lumi, Nukkit 2.0 and newer | | **BungeeCord**, Waterfall and forks (XCord, FlameCord, Travertine) | BungeeCord API 1.16 and newer | | **Velocity** | 3.4 and newer, including 4.x | Requires **Java 21** or newer (Velocity 4 requires Java 25). - For Lumi / Nukkit servers: use `Kordon-Lumi.jar` or the universal `Kordon.jar` directly in the `plugins/` directory. Real player IPs behind WaterdogPE proxies (`getWaterdogIP`) are automatically resolved and verified. - For Java proxies: install `Kordon.jar` on the proxy, not on backend servers. Geyser/Floodgate players are fully supported. ## Installation 1. [Sign up](https://panel.kordonlabs.com/register) and add your server in the Kordon panel. 2. Download `Kordon.jar` (or `Kordon-Lumi.jar`) from the server's **Plugin** page. This file is personal: it already contains your server key, so there is nothing to configure. 3. Put it into your server/proxy's `plugins` folder and restart. Alternatively, use the generic jar and link it from the **console** with `/kordon link `. The key is on the same **Plugin** page. The plugin verifies the key, saves it to `plugins/Kordon/secret.key` and connects right away, without a restart. When everything is ready, the console shows `Kordon connected to server "..."` and the panel marks the plugin as online within a minute. > Treat the server key like a password: do not share the downloaded jar or the key. If it leaks, issue a new key in > the panel and the old one stops working immediately. To update, stop the server or proxy, replace the jar and start it again. The key stays in `plugins/Kordon/secret.key`. ## Commands Every command requires `kordon.command` plus the permission listed below. The console has all permissions. | Command | Permission | Description | |---|---|---| | `/kordon`, `/kordon help` | `kordon.command` | List available commands | | `/kordon status` | `kordon.command` | Connection status, mode, key and online count | | `/kordon reload` | `kordon.command.reload` | Fetch the settings from the panel now | | `/kordon lookup ` | `kordon.command.lookup` | What Kordon knows about a player or address | | `/kordon whitelist add [duration] [note]` | `kordon.command.whitelist` | Let in without VPN and country checks | | `/kordon whitelist remove ` | `kordon.command.whitelist` | Remove from the whitelist | | `/kordon blacklist add [duration] [note]` | `kordon.command.blacklist` | Block, and disconnect if online | | `/kordon blacklist remove ` | `kordon.command.blacklist` | Remove from the blacklist | | `/kordon link ` | `kordon.command.link` | Link the server to your Kordon server | | `/kordon unlink` | `kordon.command.link` | Remove the saved key | - Aliases: `wl` / `bl`, `rm` / `del`. - Duration: `1h`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d` or `never` (default). - `--ip` targets the current IP of an online player, `--name` forces a nickname. - Enter the key in the console, not in-game, so it does not end up in chat or command logs. - In-game commands can be turned off in the panel. ## Permissions | Permission | Grants | |---|---| | `kordon.command` | Required for any `/kordon` command; status and help | | `kordon.command.lookup` | Player lookup | | `kordon.command.lookup.ip` | See IP addresses and look up by IP | | `kordon.command.whitelist` | Manage the whitelist | | `kordon.command.blacklist` | Manage the blacklist | | `kordon.command.reload` | Reload settings from the panel | | `kordon.command.link` | Link and unlink the server/proxy (give it to the owner only) | | `kordon.notify` | Staff notifications in chat | ## Data sent to Kordon For each login: nickname, UUID, IP address, protocol version, skin (online mode), whether the player is a Bedrock player, the address the player connected to, and later the backend server, client brand and language. About the server/proxy: platform and version, plugin version, machine name, online count and response time. The plugin does not collect chat, player commands or any other client data. ## Developer API Other plugins can react to Kordon decisions. Add `Kordon.jar` as a `compileOnly` dependency. | Event | Fired when | You can | |---|---|---| | `KordonLoginCheckedEvent` | Kordon has decided whether to let a player in | Read the verdict and reasons, change the kick message, or cancel a block to let the player in | | `KordonRemoteKickEvent` | Kordon is about to disconnect a player on a panel command or a blacklist entry | Change the message or cancel the kick | Packages: - `com.kordonlabs.plugin.nukkit.api` (Lumi / Nukkit) - `com.kordonlabs.plugin.bungee.api` (BungeeCord, `softDepends: [Kordon]`) - `com.kordonlabs.plugin.velocity.api` (Velocity, `"dependencies": [{"id": "kordon", "optional": true}]`) Events are fired asynchronously off the server/proxy's main thread; keep handlers fast and thread-safe. ```java // Nukkit / Lumi example @EventHandler public void onChecked(KordonLoginCheckedEvent event) { if (event.isBlocked() && isTrusted(event.getConnection())) { event.setCancelled(true); } } ``` ## Building from source Requires JDK 21 or newer. ```bash ./gradlew build ``` The universal plugin jar is written to `kordon-universal/build/libs/Kordon.jar`. The dedicated Lumi/Nukkit plugin jar is written to `kordon-nukkit/build/libs/Kordon-Lumi.jar`. To point a build at another Kordon API address, pass `-PkordonApiUrl=https://...`. | Module | Contents | |---|---| | `kordon-common` | Platform-independent core: login checks, panel connection, sessions, commands | | `kordon-nukkit` | Lumi and Nukkit (Minecraft Bedrock) integration | | `kordon-bungee` | BungeeCord and Waterfall integration | | `kordon-velocity` | Velocity integration | | `kordon-universal` | Packages all platforms into a single `Kordon.jar` | ## License Kordon is licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/StefanFox-Dev/mc-kordon-plugin-bedrock/blob/main/LICENSE).

### Changes in v1.11.1

- Enhanced Velocity spoofer for Bedrock / Nukkit
- Java deterministic offline UUID generation for online players, login and lookups
- Bedrock port 19132 mapped to default Java 25565 virtualHost fallback
- Backend server connection, vanilla brand and client settings emulation upon join

versions.changelog:
Kordon 1.11.0 — Lumi, BungeeCord, Waterfall, Velocity и прокси на их основе (например, XCord), нужна Java 21 или новее

### Changes from upstream 1.11.0:
- Merged upstream Kordon 1.11.0 changes: ClientSettings tracking, BungeeChannels & VelocityChannels fake connection mitigation.
- Full Bedrock Edition & Floodgate support:
  - Supports Bedrock gamertags containing spaces in authentication and API sync.
  - Strips raw § color codes from Bedrock kick messages to avoid client glitches.
  - Waterdog / WaterdogPE proxy support.
  - Native Lumi / Nukkit Bedrock module.

### Downloads:
- **Kordon.jar**: Universal proxy plugin (BungeeCord, Waterfall, Velocity)
- **Kordon-Bungee.jar**: Standalone BungeeCord / Waterfall plugin
- **Kordon-Velocity.jar**: Standalone Velocity plugin
- **Kordon-Lumi.jar**: Native Lumi / Nukkit server plugin
versions.name: Release 1.11.0

versions.changelog:
## Kordon 1.10.0 (Bedrock & Lumi Edition)

### Что нового:
- **Синхронизация с официальным обновлением Kordon 1.10.0**:
  - Добавлены модули чтения статистики соединений: ConnStats, ConnStatsReader, BungeeConn, VelocityConn.
  - Добавлено периодическое сэмплирование и агрегация статистики соединений в сессиях (SessionTracker, TrackedSession).
  - Передача сетевой статистики в LoginGate.
- **Исправление входа игроков с Bedrock с пробелами в никах**:
  - При отправке запроса в панель пробелы в нике Bedrock-игроков заменяются на _ и длина ограничивается до 16 символов, предотвращая ошибку панели 400 Bad Request.
- **Очистка цветов при кике игроков с Bedrock**:
  - Удалены все коды цветов § из сообщений об отказе во входе и удаленном кике для Bedrock-клиентов, чтобы экран отключения не ломался.
- **Закрытие уязвимости со спуфингом Waterdog IP**:
  - Клиентский заголовок LoginChainData.getWaterdogIP() принимается только если проксирование Waterdog действительно активно в настройках сервера Nukkit/Lumi (useWaterdog), иначе используется подтвержденный адрес сокета.

### Файлы для скачивания:
- **Kordon-Lumi.jar** — готовый плагин для Lumi / Nukkit (помещается в папку plugins/).
- **Kordon.jar** — универсальный плагин (подходит для Bungee, Velocity, Nukkit).
- **kordon-bungee-1.10.0.jar** — плагин для BungeeCord / WaterdogPE.
- **kordon-velocity-1.10.0.jar** — плагин для Velocity.
versions.name: Release 1.10.0

versions.changelog:
## Kordon 1.9.1 — Поддержка Bedrock (Lumi / Nukkit) & Java Universal

### Что нового:
- **Интеграция с ядром Lumi (Nukkit Bedrock)**: добавлен полноценный платформенный модуль kordon-nukkit.
- **Современная архитектура Lumi EventBus**: регистрация слушателей напрямую через шину событий ядра без использования устаревшего интерфейса Listener.
- **Асинхронная проверка входов (PlayerAsyncPreLoginEvent)**: надежная блокировка VPN, прокси, ботов и нежелательных подключений до допуска игрока на сервер без задержек основного тика.
- **Поддержка WaterdogPE**: автоматическое определение реального IP-адреса игрока (getWaterdogIP) за Bedrock-прокси.
- **Интеграция с веб-панелью Kordon**: онлайн-мониторинг, статистика в реальном времени, вайтлист/блеклист, фильтры стран/ников и удаленные кики игроков в один клик.
- **Universal Jar**: универсальный Kordon.jar теперь поддерживает BungeeCord, Velocity и Lumi/Nukkit в одном файле.

---

### Файлы релиза (Assets):
- **Kordon-Lumi.jar**: оптимизированный плагин для серверов Lumi / Nukkit Bedrock.
- **Kordon.jar**: универсальная мультиплатформенная сборка (BungeeCord / Velocity / Lumi).
versions.name: Kordon 1.9.1 - Bedrock (Lumi) & Java Universal
